text:
zara: Morning — saw ~30 tiny-gang evictions in eu-west1 this hour, all in racks with lots of 2-slot hosts.
mike: same. They get packed onto 2-slot "thin-shelf" hosts and then evicted when a big gang boots.
lee: sample event from scheduler: 
```
EventType=PreemptAttempt pod=tiny-infer-311 node=eu-west1-rc12-slot2 reason=taint.score>0.88
scheduler_meta: node_slots=2 allocated_slots=2 preemptible=true reschedule_delay=7s
```
irina: telemetry shows short-lived `egress-flood` taints from conntrack pressure on that rack around the same time. Nodes flip tainted -> sched evicts -> nodes recover -> pods bounce back -> thrash.
infra-bot: autoscaler: added +2 nodes in eu-west1-rc13 at 2026-03-22T09:02Z (event id: 8f9d)
zara: quick impact: small-workloads team reported ~15% higher GPU-hours allocated for tiny jobs over the last 24h. Cost spike is visible.
mike: low-effort mitigations: 1) treat `egress-flood` as transient — wait before preempting, 2) soft avoid thin-shelves for tiny-gangs, 3) prefer compact-packing for tiny jobs so they don't scatter.
lee: propose scheduler knobs: `taint_recovery_grace=30s`, `thin_shelf_soft_weight=25`, and `prefer_compact_for<=8gpus`.
irina: add metrics: `eviction.thrash.tiny_gang` counter and `scheduler.preempt_delay_seconds` histogram. Dashboard needs per-rack breakdown.
infra-bot: noted. will append structured scale events & taint notices to thread.
zara: config sketch: 
```
apiVersion: scheduler.redwood/v1
kind: StabilityPolicy
metadata:
  name: thin-shelf-guardrails
spec:
  taintRecoveryGraceSeconds: "30"
  avoidThinShelfSoft: "true"
  thinShelfPreferenceWeight: "25"
  compactPlacementThresholdGPUs: "8"
```
mike: testing plan: stage racks with toxiproxy simulating conntrack spikes for 2h, run tiny-gang arrival at 20rps and measure `eviction.thrash.tiny_gang`.
lee: rollout plan: canary scheduler patch to 4% eu-west1 at 03:00 UTC, monitor `eviction.thrash.tiny_gang`, `reschedule_delay_p95`, and `gpu.effective_runtime`. Rollback if evictions > baseline+12% in 2h.
irina: I'll own telemetry & alert: fire pager if `eviction.thrash.tiny_gang > 4/min for 5m`. Also silence repetitive slack alerts.
zara: owners: @lee do canary, @mike run staging sim, @irina add metrics/alert, infra-bot publish autoscaler events.
lee: opening PR with config and test plan now. Will include cost delta estimate.
mike: ping me on the PR for staging job setup.
irina: grep helper to find events: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l app=scheduler -c scheduler | grep -E "PreemptAttempt|reschedule_delay|egress-flood"`
zara: thanks all — aim to promote after 24h healthy canary. :thumbsup:
